title: Apartment Movers in Burbank | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Apartment movers in Burbank: hourly crews, a $50 COI for your manager, loading-only curb rules and a plan for dingbats and courtyard buildings.
heroSubtitle: Two, three or four movers with a truck for Burbank studios, one-bedrooms and family units, billed by the hour any day of the week between 8AM and 6PM.

faq.question: Do I need a parking permit for the moving truck in Burbank?
faq.answer: Not a parking permit: Burbank does not issue temporary parking permits to contractors. The code lets a marked commercial truck stop in a residential zone while it is loading or unloading, and that is how our crew works at the curb. We keep clear of crosswalk approaches and agree on the spot with you before move day.

faq.question: Can you send my Burbank building manager a certificate of insurance?
faq.answer: Yes. The certificate costs $50 and names the owner, management company or HOA your manager asks us to list. Send the manager's contact and requirements when you book, and we deliver the document to the office before move day.

faq.question: What does a one-bedroom apartment move in Burbank cost?
faq.answer: Hourly, so the clock decides the total. For a pair of movers with a truck, the weekday rates (Monday to Thursday) are $119 in cash and $129 on a card, and from Friday to Sunday they are $135 and $145. The floor is 3 hours and gas is a flat $30; stairs, the carry to the truck and shelves left unpacked are what stretch the time.

faq.question: Can you move me out of my Burbank apartment today?
faq.answer: Often, yes: same-day moves are possible whenever a crew is free. The working day runs 8AM to 6PM on every day of the week, so the earlier in the day you phone 909-443-0004, the better the odds. Rates and the 3-hour minimum match those of a booking made weeks ahead.

faq.question: I just moved onto a preferential-permit street. Where do I park my own car?
faq.answer: Since January 1, 2025, Burbank ties residential permits to license plates and checks them with plate-reading enforcement. If no bill at the new address is in your name yet, the city can give you a temporary permit valid for up to 30 days. It cannot be renewed, so apply for the regular permit while it is still running.

faq.question: Is a move from Burbank to another state priced by the hour?
faq.answer: No. Moves out of California get a flat rate built on volume, route and services, and they run under USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871. Our Burbank long-distance team explains how that quote is put together.
